meta.status: ILLUSTRATIVE assumptions only (fictional parameters). Numerical results are [F] (floating point); the theorems they illustrate are [L] (standard renewal theory); their application to buildings is [H].
meta.replacement_emission_per_event: u = 1 (normalised; multiply by the emission of one replacement)

fixed_cycle.rule: event at tau counted iff tau < T*(1-eps) (atom kernel h(T; tau, 0, tau))
fixed_cycle.note: count_kernel equals ceil(T(1-eps)/c)-1 except possibly in bands of relative width ~1e-9 at the knots (switching point sw(tau) of lemma L-2); floor(T/c) is the right-continuous renewal convention N(t) = #{n: tau_n <= t}. At T = kc exactly the concept model does not count the k-th event (0 at T = 15 for c = 15).

age_functions.g_efficiency: exp(b * a): electricity multiplier 1/eta(a) * eta_0 for eta(a) = eta_0 exp(-b a)
age_functions.g_stock: q ** a: remaining fraction of a stock charged at the last renewal

discrete_renewal.note: u_n = P(a renewal in year n) for integer lifetimes; u_0 = 1, u_n = sum_k f_k u_{n-k}
